description: Drainage District Embankments is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Office of Public Works. Abstract: This data shows the embankments forming part of Drainage Districts. Embankments are walls of soil or sods that were constructed to protect low lying ground from flooding (not properties). Drains and sluices or pumps were also provided to take away rainwater that fell behind the embankments. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Office of Public Works. Its tags are drainage district, drainage system, flooding, hydraulic engineering, river. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2022-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
